cohort: 163 pregnant women admitted to the high-risk pregnancy unit with COVID-19 between December 2021 and February 2022
finding: Vaccinated pregnant women had milder COVID-19 symptoms and more favorable pregnancy outcomes compared to unvaccinated pregnant women.
mod_finding: The rate of C-section was higher in unvaccinated women, and the mean birthweight percentile in their infants was negatively impacted by COVID-19 infection compared to those born to vaccinated women.
